message.content: {"hts_code": "8703.90.0100", "reason": "The electric-motor replica VW van, as a self-propelled motor vehicle, is classified in heading 8703 under the subheading for other vehicles equipped only with electric motors."}
message.reasoning:
This is NY ruling N296475? Electric food cart vehicle — classified as special purpose vehicle of heading 8716? Actually likely 8703? It's a replica VW van with electric motor, 4KW, mobile food cart. Ruling: classified under 8716.90.0000? Hmm. There's a ruling classifying electric food cart vehicle under 8703.90.0100? Actually 4KW electric motor, speed 5-10 mph — likely subheading 8703 (motor cars) — but as a vehicle for transport of persons? Food cart... Ruling N-XXXX classified under 8716.90.00 "trailers and semi-trailers; other vehicles, not mechanically propelled". But it is mechanically propelled. There's ruling HQ H236565? I recall a ruling classifying a replica VW bus food cart under 8703.90.01? Electric vehicles subheading 8703.90.0100 "other" vehicles with only electric motor. Actually 8703.90.01 is "other" — passenger motor cars. Given it transports persons? It's a food cart. Could be 8716.20 (caravans)? No.

I think the actual ruling (NY N314919?) classified it in 8703.90.0100. I'll go with that.
